tips.text: Hit the daily cap with mission affinity first, then turn in Syndicate Alert rewards and medallions, which ignore the cap.
Cap the day fast in Elite Sanctuary Onslaught, leaving around round 8, or in the Duviri Circuit past stage 4.
Use a loot radar such as Thief's Wit or Animal Instinct to find medallions; they hide off the main path behind vents and grates.
Skip Interception and Defense alerts when hunting medallions; they usually spawn none or one.
Rank up before your next mission or medallion turn-in; standing past a rank's maximum is lost.
Do not expect standing alone to lift Red Veil out of a negative rank; each negative rank has its own sacrifice.
Expect Arbiters of Hexis to drop into negative standing fast once you pledge Red Veil.
Pledge New Loka or Perrin Sequence before Red Veil if you want several syndicates; Red Veil does not touch them, and Steel Meridian as a pair angers the other four.
Buy the other Rakta weapons on the same visit; they use the same Red Veil rank and give separate Mastery.
Players treat the relay syndicates as a slow, low-stress background grind of a few weeks at the daily cap.
